_comment: Project-level markdownlint rule config. Read by markdownlint-cli2 when CPV passes it via --config (see cpv_lint_engine.py: target_config = repo_root / '.markdownlint.json'). This file mirrors the CPV-canonical rule set, so behaviour stays deterministic whether CPV is loaded from the local cache or fetched fresh from GitHub HEAD via `uvx --from git+https://github.com/Emasoft/claude-plugins-validation`.
